questions.prompt: Which deployment target does NOT support Server Actions, dynamic Route Handlers, or middleware?

options.text: A Node server via next start

questions.explanation: A static export has no running server, so request-time features (SSR-on-request, Server Actions, dynamic Route Handlers, middleware) don't work.

questions.prompt: What prefix exposes an environment variable to the browser? Type it (including the underscore).
questions.explanation: Only variables prefixed with NEXT_PUBLIC_ are exposed to the client; all others remain server-only.

questions.prompt: Which are true about a static export? Select all that apply.

options.text: It emits static files you can host on GitHub Pages or S3
Server Actions run at request time

questions.explanation: A static export is static-only: hostable anywhere, images unoptimized, dynamic routes pre-rendered via generateStaticParams. Server Actions need a server.

questions.prompt: Match each deployment target to its characteristic.

pairs.right: All features, you run the server
Config for hosting under a sub-path

questions.explanation: Vercel and Node self-hosting support the full feature set; a static export is static-only; basePath handles sub-path hosting.

questions.prompt: Order the steps to ship a static export to a sub-path static host.

items.text: Set output: 'export', basePath, and images.unoptimized in next.config
Run next build to generate static files
Upload the generated output to the static host
Visit the sub-path URL and verify links/assets resolve

questions.explanation: Configure the export and base path, build the static output, deploy it, and verify the sub-path routing works.
